decisions.reason: The deletion applies to the dedication page; the copyright page content and layout remain unchanged.
Deleting lines from the dedication does not change Chapter 12 heading hierarchy or typography.
The source changes dedication content only and does not alter the general interior layout, trim size, spacing, or page-density rules.
The dedication text deletion does not affect chapter illustration selection, placement, size, or rendering quality.
The source does not change the requirement for page numbers or the table-of-contents update behavior.
The local context resolves the requested deletion to the dedication page, not the interior title page.
Deleting dedication lines does not change the italic styling required for Mama's Hot Take callouts.
The source concerns dedication content and does not affect the book-title newline-artifact constraint.
The dedication is front matter, and its text deletion does not change the requested back matter or author copy.
Although both involve document content, the source specifically modifies the independently tracked dedication page and does not change any current copyediting attribute.
The dedication-page deletion does not affect the paperback cover artifact, cover content, trim size, or editorial-review requirement.
The source changes dedication text only and does not alter KDP keywords, metadata delivery format, or intended use.
